title: v1_144 / Release highlights
content: ## Release highlights This release helps you keep agent work moving across environments, find the right models for each task, and stay in control of changes and tool calls. * [Session continuity](#session-continuity): Manage remotes in one place and keep sessions and automations running even when your computer is off. * [Copilot Fusion and model comparisons](#models): Let Copilot choose and orchestrate models, or compare models side by side. * [Image generation (Preview)](#image-generation-in-copilot-preview): Create and edit images directly in chat. * [Computer use (Experimental)](#let-agents-use-desktop-apps-with-computer-use): Let agents use desktop apps on your computer. * [Working set (Experimental)](#review-copilot-file-edits-with-the-working-set-experimental): Keep or undo agent file edits in the editor. * [Assisted permissions](#assisted-permissions-are-generally-available): Reduce interruptions with automatic approval for tool calls that pass a risk check. * [Customization marketplace](#discover-marketplace-customizations-preview) and [Copilot connectors](#connect-services-with-copilot-connectors-preview) (Preview): Discover skills and plugins for your workflow, and bring context from Slack, Notion, and other services into your agent sessions.
